title: refactor(types)!: burn ledger batch 2 — page/navigation/misc symbols stop wearing spec names
body:
Ledger burn-down batch 2 of 8 — closes the page / navigation / misc cluster of `@object-ui/types`. Sub-issue objectui#3156, tracking issue objectstack#4115.

**Ledger: 45 → 29 collisions** (measured against main after batches 4 and 5 landed), `@object-ui/types` **19 → 3**. The three left are batch 8's, and the 13 other packages' entries are byte-identical.

## Per-symbol verdicts

Sixteen symbols, resolved two ways. No ALLOW entry was needed this round.

### Derived — the spec supplies the keys, by reference (7)

| symbol | how | why this and not a rename |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ActionParam` | `Omit<z.input<typeof ActionParamSchema>, 'type'>` | authoring shape of the spec's own param, not another concept |
| `CreateExportJobRequest` | `Omit<CreateExportJobInput, 'object'>` | `object` is the method's `resource` argument, not a payload key |
| `CreateExportJobResult` | re-export `@objectstack/spec/contracts` | member-identical bar an optional/required skew |
| `ImportRowResult` | re-export `@objectstack/spec/api` | same |
| `NavigationArea` | `Omit<SpecNavigationArea, 'navigation' \| 'visible'>` | same concept; two keys pinned, see below |
| `NavigationAreaSchema` | `specFieldsExcept(SpecNavigationAreaSchema.shape, …)` | zod twin of the above |
| `Theme` | re-export of `ThemeInput` | **member-identical** to the spec's authoring type |

`ExportJobFormat` rode along as an eighth (re-export of the spec's `ExportFormat`): it was a hand union of the same five members sitting next to a type I was deriving, i.e. exactly the state a copy is in one release before it is wrong.

**`z.input` everywhere it matters.** `ActionParam.required` carries `.default(false)` and `visible` a canonicalizing pipe; `Theme.mode` carries `.default('auto')`; `CreateExportJobRequest` defaults `format`/`includeHeaders`/`encoding`. Deriving from `z.infer` would have made a caller supply all of them. This is the rule from objectui#3169 — *writing side → input, reading side → infer* — and `Theme` is its cleanest case: the old interface's own comment said "ObjectUI uses the input shape" while it hand-copied the type anyway.

**Two keys pinned on `NavigationArea`**, each with a reason that outlives a spec release:
- `navigation` — objectui's own `NavigationItem`. Under rc.0 the reason was the `any` erasure; **rc.1 typed the spec's item and the reason changed under the branch** (see "The rc.1 bump" below). It is still not bindable, on case 2c: precise but a different shape, and objectui's items carry `visible: boolean`, which the spec rejects at every tier.
- `visible` — objectui's wire contract is the bare predicate; the spec's parsed shape is the `{ dialect, source }` envelope. Same divergence and same reason as `SelectOption.visibleWhen` (objectui#3090).

### Renamed — same word, different concept (9)

| was | now | the two things that shared the name |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `FileMetadata` | `UploadedFileMetadata` | field-VALUE payload (`url`, `original_name`, snake_case) ↔ storage file record (`path`, `etag`, `mimeType`) |
| `GestureType` | `TouchGestureType` | direction fused into the name (`swipe-left`) ↔ type + separate `swipe.direction`; the unions share only 3 of 10/7 members |
| `GestureConfig` | `TouchGestureConfig` | gesture→`action` binding ↔ per-gesture tuning record with no notion of what the gesture does |
| `OfflineConfig` | `PWAOfflineConfig` | service-worker route caching ↔ offline data/sync model |
| `PageRegion` | `PageNodeRegion` | region holding `SchemaNode`s ↔ region holding authored `PageComponent`s |
| `PageRegionSchema` | `PageNodeRegionSchema` | zod twin of the above |
| `ResponsiveConfig` | `MobileResponsiveConfig` | mobile box config (`gap`, `stackOnMobile`) ↔ SDUI grid contract (`hiddenOn`, `order`) |
| `WidgetManifest` | `RuntimeWidgetManifest` | SDUI component manifest ↔ field-widget plugin manifest |
| `WidgetSource` | `RuntimeWidgetSource` | both discriminate on `type` and **both have an `inline` member**: one carries a resolved component, the other source code |

`PageNodeRegion` follows the layer split that objectui#3074 already made for `PageNodeSchema`. `ResponsiveConfig` and `PageRegion` were the easiest calls of the batch: this package **already re-exported the spec's own under `SpecResponsiveConfig` / `SpecPageRegion`**, so the bare names were claiming an authority that had visibly been handed elsewhere.

Every new name was run through the guard before use (the objectui#3074 lesson, which cost batch 3 three candidates). None collided this round.

## Cross-package decisions (recorded on objectstack#4115)

- **`OfflineConfig` — the name stays with `@object-ui/react`.** Counter-intuitively, `@object-ui/react`'s `useOffline` config *is* the spec's concept, key for key; `@object-ui/types`' is the service-worker layer (its strategy type was already renamed to `FetchCacheStrategy` back in group A). So types renames, and batch 5 derives and keeps the name — which is what objectui#3199 did.
- **`Theme` — no new dialect name needed anywhere.** types now re-exports the spec's `ThemeInput`. Batch 7's `@object-ui/providers:Theme` should be triaged on the same axis: authoring JSON → `ThemeInput`, resolved runtime theme → `z.infer`. Either way it derives.

## Live defects this surfaced

Not cosmetic drift — things that were wrong at runtime or unrepresentable:

1. **`ActionParam` never declared `reference`** — the key `resolveActionParams()` actually reads for an inline lookup target. The dev-mode warning in `paramToField.ts` tells authors to "Declare `reference: '<object>'`", naming a key the public type did not have, while the type offered `referenceTo`, which nothing reads. Filed as **objectui#3174** (the fix changes what the resolver reads, so it does not ride here). Deriving restores `reference`, and also `defaultFromRow` — which the metadata designer's own inspector writes — and `requiresFeature`.
2. **`visible` was narrower than the runtime.** The resolver has always accepted the `{ dialect, source }` envelope; the type declared only the bare string.
3. **`CreateExportJobResult.createdAt` and `ImportRowResult.action`** were optional here and required by the server — every consumer carried a branch that could not run. Requiring them exposed two places typing server responses by hand: a synthetic error row in `ImportWizard` now states `action: 'failed'`, and app-shell's identity-import response reuses the shared contract instead of re-listing it.
4. **`NavigationArea.id` accepted any string.** The spec's own length rule now applies.
5. **A stale justification, again.** `data.ts` kept hand copies "to keep `@object-ui/types` zero-dependency" while `@objectstack/spec` was already a direct dependency *and the same file imported from it three lines up*. Identical rot to the `external/api.ts` case in objectui#3169 — when a comment says "kept local to avoid depending on X", open `package.json` first.
6. **A justification that expired without moving.** `ActionParam.label` was pinned as a widening to "a string or a per-locale record". In spec 17 `I18nLabelSchema` is `z.ZodString` — inline i18n objects were dropped for translation files — so the override had become an exact restatement of the spec's type while still claiming to be wider. Both `label` and `options[].label` are now inherited, with an inverted pin so a future re-widening re-opens the decision instead of inheriting the old one.

## The rc.1 bump caught one of this branch's own premises

Merging main brought `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0-rc.1 (objectui#3178) plus batches 4 and 5. rc.1 gave `NavigationItem` a real type — so the reason this branch had written down for pinning `NavigationArea.navigation`, *"the spec erases it to `any`"*, expired mid-review, and **the inverted pin fired exactly as designed**: `tsc` refused the assertion and pointed at the note to re-read.

Re-triaged rather than patched: the override stands, but on **case 2c** instead of case 2. The pin no longer asserts the erasure that used to imply the blocker; it asserts the blocker — an objectui area whose item carries `visible: boolean`, which the spec's type rejects at every tier — and points at `spec-derived-unions.test.ts`, where objectui#3177 pins the other two. This is the same correction objectui#3177 made repo-wide, and it is the concrete argument for why these pins are written inverted: *"no longer `any`" is not "safe to bind"*.

## Verification

All re-run after the merge, on rc.1:

- **Ledger** — `--ledger` regenerated and set-diffed against main: `removed` is exactly this batch's 16, `added` is empty, all 13 other packages unchanged. 45 → 29 in 14 packages.
- **Guard** — green (`1202 files scanned against 4344 spec export names; 9 declared dialects, 29 untriaged collisions`).
- **Type-check** — `turbo build --filter=@object-ui/types` first, then `turbo type-check --force`: **78/78** (per-package tsc resolves the old dist otherwise, the objectui#3169 trap). Test files are compiled too via `tsconfig.test.json`, so the type-level pins in the new parity file are real gates — which is how the rc.1 premise change was caught rather than merged past.
- **Tests** — full suite green in chunks: **811 files, 9559 passed, 25 skipped, 0 failed**, including the 40 new assertions.
- **Lint** — 0 errors on changed files.
- **Mutation tests**, three, re-run after the merge, all red then restored to green:
  1. revert `RuntimeWidgetManifest` → `WidgetManifest`: guard red **by name and by file** (`widget.ts:54`);
  2. re-fork `NavigationAreaSchema` as a hand-written `z.object({…})`: guard red (`app.zod.ts:132`) **and** parity test red;
  3. leave a burned name in `DEBT`: rot ratchet red (`lists 1 symbol in DEBT that no longer collide — Theme`).

Mutation 2 is worth calling out: on the first pass **the parity test stayed green** under a faithful hand copy — all 39 key-set, parse and divergence assertions pass, because the copy really was faithful. Only reference identity distinguishes a derivation from a fork (objectui#3003, re-proved on `isAggregatedViewContainer` in objectui#3169). The test now asserts the spec's sub-schemas are identical (`toBe`) one `.unwrap()` deep — `specFieldsExcept` ends in `.partial()`, whose fresh `ZodOptional` wrapper is the only new allocation — and both gates now fail.

## Merge notes

Conflicted with main on the shared DEBT hot spot after batches 4/5 landed. Resolved mechanically, not by hand-picking lines: took main's `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` **wholesale** — it carries the rewritten case 2, the new case 2c, and three ALLOW entries this branch never touched — then regenerated the DEBT block with `--ledger`. `packages/types/src/app.ts` kept main's objectui#3177 import block and module header verbatim, adding only the one import this branch's derivation needs.

## Notes for review

- The renames are **breaking type changes with no deprecation aliases**; an alias would preserve exactly the ambiguity being removed. Changeset included, with a migration table. Both concepts stay reachable under distinguishable names in every case.
- The `PageRegionWidth` / `PageRegionWidthSchema` aliases keep their names: not spec exports, and their members are exactly the spec's `width` enum.
- `WidgetSourceModule` / `WidgetSourceInline` / `WidgetSourceRegistry` keep theirs for the same reason — renaming them would churn the public surface without removing a collision.

Refs objectui#3156, objectstack#4115. Do not merge before review; the sub-issue stays open until this lands.
